items.title: Spring Office Hours: S5E20 - The Developer's Guide to AI with Danny Thompson
items.description: Join Dan Vega and DaShaun Carter for the latest updates from the Spring Ecosystem. In this episode, Dan and DaShaun are joined by Danny Thompson, Senior Developer Advocate at Atlassian, co-host of The Programming Podcast, and founder of The Commit Your Code Conference. Danny is also a co-author of the new No Starch Press book "The Developer's Guide to AI: A Field Guide for the Working Developer." We will talk about his path from a decade in gas stations to a career in software, what it takes to run a conference that donates 100% of ticket revenue to charity, and how working developers can build real AI systems without a data science degree. You can participate in our live stream to ask questions or catch the replay on your preferred podcast platform.

items.title: The OpenAI Story Actually Scares Me
items.description:
Hextree AI courses: https://app.hextree.io/map/artificial-intelligence (ad)

At Black Hat, OpenAI gave a talk with preliminary results of their investigation into the Hugging Face incident. And besides multiple zero-days exploited by agents, the agents communicated using a message board. It is absolutely insane and probably the most scary thing I have heard about AI so far.

items.title: OpenAI's models hacked a package manager to cheat evals - Ryan Greenblatt
HackTheBox - Cobblestone
items.description:
00:00 - Introduction
01:00 - Start of nmap
03:00 - Creating an account on the main domain and discovering it doesn't create one on vote
05:30 - Discovering a SQL Injection when suggesting URL's on the vote application, converting it to Union Injection and showing SQLMap
10:15 - Union injection working, getting the payload over to SQLMAP so we can have it dump the database while we look at other things
15:30 - Going back to the Skin Suggestor, discovering XSS
17:50 - Having the XSS Send us back the page the victim is on, discovering a debug page is linked which contains PHPINFO
23:15 - The PHPINFO output reflects the PHP Cookie, creating a CSRF Payload to have the victim navigate to the PHPINFO page and send us the output to steal their cookies even thoe they are marked HTTPONLY
28:15 - Discovering SSTI, this is PHP so using a PHP TWIG Payload to get RCE, some commands fail discovering it is apparmor
35:15 - Failing to get a reverse shell for a while
41:08 - Using MySQL Dump to dump the database, the SQL injection didn't get this because its a different DB
45:50 - Shell returned as Cobblestone
51:00 - Discovering Cobbler is running, forward the post back to us, use XMLRPC to get RCE (a 2014 GitHub issue)
54:20 - Having Claude look at the issue and try to make a POC while we poke at it manually
58:48 - Proving we can bypass auth with -1 as the password, and getting shell

items.title: Grafana Campfire 🔥 - Assistant powered Dynamic dashboards - (Grafana Community Call - August 2026)
items.description:
Many times, it feels like you're maintaining multiple versions of the same dashboard (with a slight modification), *OR* simply spending more time writing queries rather than actually looking at the actual data?

In this Campfire community call, we're taking a deep dive into two things that are reshaping how Grafana dashboards get built: Dynamic Dashboards and the Grafana AI Assistant  and showing you how to combine them to go from a blank canvas to a reusable, production-ready dashboard in minutes.

*Hosts:* Syed Usman Ahmad and Myrle Krantz
*Experts:* Daniel Moosdeen and Kristina Demeshchik
*Moderator:* Carl Bergquist

*We will discuss about:*
🧩 Dynamic Dashboards
🤖 Grafana AI Assistant in Action
⚡ A Live Build, Demo (from hours to minutes)
♻️ Reusable, Multi-Purpose Dashboards
💡 What's Coming Next

*Bring your questions* as it is a live conversation, and we want to hear what you're building and what's slowing you down today using this link:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1GpgvanMeNqf-CDegv6E0yAV1s2f7H2knUFuNouqwX3A/edit?tab=t.lm728fbg09f2#heading=h.39my9s8k81lr

*Who this is for:* Whether you're new to Grafana and want a fast, low-friction way to get value from your data, or you're an experienced user drowning in near-duplicate dashboards, this session is designed to meet you where you are.

By the end, you'll understand not just what the AI Assistant can do today, but where dashboard creation in Grafana is headed next.

#ai #grafana #dashboard #visualization
